reason: The default stable ground here is date-palm farm canopy, which drifts against bare ground in the same farms (toward the anti-sun direction, and it responds to sun elevation as shadows do). No canopy-free reference could be shown stable to 0.1 m/yr: hard surfaces outside the farm polygons and bare ground inside the farms are both canopy-free and both pass the matcher's tests, but their trends differ by ~0.2 m/yr. So the registration is their mean and the speeds carry half their difference as a systematic uncertainty. The megadune bodies cannot serve as a reference (the body-scale matcher fails its known-shift test, section 15b). Transfer from Sweihan is tested below and not used (row 044 and row 043 per-date offsets do not track each other, and their difference in the overlap has a trend). Tests and decision rules were written down before the speeds were computed (pipeline/site_notes/liwa/02_registration_reference.md).
